Rosie Quint

Hello! I am a second-year Master’s student in Biostatistics at the Bloomberg School of Public Health, Johns Hopkins University. I am currently researching the use of cox proportional hazards models to identify protein risk and diagnosis biomarkers from the ARIC study’s proteomic cohort data. In my spare time I love hiking, music, and travelling.
